component.name: Glyphie
component.summary: Fast libcosmic-native emoji picker with skin tone and gender support

description.p: Glyphie is a fast, lightweight emoji picker. Select emojis with skin tone and gender preferences, search by name or keyword, and copy directly to your clipboard with a single click.

ul.li: Multiselect mode - select multiple emojis and copy all at once
Keyboard navigation for highlighting and copying emojis
Single instance - launching again focuses the running picker
Start on Recent for faster repeat picks
Single-instance activation focuses the running picker
Wayland clipboard persistence after copy and close
Improved search ranking, recent matching, and emoji presentation
Toggle multiselect mode to select multiple emojis
Selection tray shows selected emojis with remove buttons
Copy all selected emojis at once
Enter key copies selection, Escape clears it
Visual feedback when at 20 emoji selection limit
